description: Compute a stock's dividend yield (annual dividend per share / share price) and, given trailing EPS, its payout ratio (dividend / EPS) and retention ratio (100 - payout ratio). A payout ratio over 100% is valid and reported as-is. Pure arithmetic, no live quote feed.

annualDividendPerShare.description: Total dividend paid per share over the trailing year

epsPerShare.description: Optional trailing earnings per share, used to compute payout and retention ratio

name: calculate_dividend_yield
